title_original: Who Are the Most Faked Artists in History?
editorial_title_zh: 历史中被伪造最多的艺术家是谁？
editorial_excerpt_zh: 一些专家估计，二级艺术市场中大约有一半是赝品和归属错误的艺术品。
editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "是什么让一件艺术品成为真品？这个看似简单直接的问题实际上可能饱含争议。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "人们通常认为伪造的艺术品是对现有作品的复制。这似乎已经足够清晰，但当艺术家复制他或她自己的作品时又该如何界定？另一方面，伪作（forgery）则是模仿艺术家的风格来创作新作品。但如果被模仿的艺术家恰恰是那些挑战艺术原创性概念并借用他人图像的人呢？", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "艺术骗局可能会变得扑朔迷离。然而它们却屡禁不止。一些专家估计，二级艺术市场中大约有一半是赝品和归属错误的艺术品。某些非真品——由汉·凡·米格伦（制作了虚假的维米尔作品）和沃尔夫冈·贝尔特拉奇（制造了数以百计的假作品）等声名狼藉的造假者制作——因其猎奇性以及被揭露的故事而备受追捧。有时，艺术品最初可能被斥为赝品，但后来通过科学分析被鉴定为真品。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "博物馆也无法对这些现象免疫。例如，纽约大都会艺术博物馆收藏了一幅1624年西班牙国王腓力四世的肖像画，该馆在20世纪70年代曾认为它是迭戈·委拉斯开兹的助手创作的，但在2010年又将其完全重新鉴定为这位西班牙巴洛克画家的真迹。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "如有疑问，专家们会依靠艺术鉴定的“三足鼎立”标准：风格审查、来源记录和科学分析。（委拉斯开兹作品的重新归属就要归功于后者，即在清除清漆之后。）", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在一本名为《伪造品、假货与复制品》的1963年综合著作中，作者乔治·萨维奇在序言结尾写道：“收藏家可以备受鼓舞，因为在艺术市场历史上的任何时期，造假都从未像现在这样艰难，也从未像现在这样容易被发现，而且造假者的任务正在变得持续艰难。”即便如此，在随后的几十年里，造假者似乎并没有收手。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "以下是九位最常被仿冒和造假的艺术家。", "translated": true}, {"type": "list_item", "text": "让-巴蒂斯特-卡米耶·柯罗（1796–1875）图片来源：特拉华大学藏品。https://exhibitions.lib.udel.edu/things-arent-what-they-seem/home/art-forgery/ 关于法国画家让-巴蒂斯特-卡米耶·柯罗，艺术史学家勒内·于格有一句名言，他声称：“柯罗画了三千幅画布，其中有一万幅在美国售出。”柯罗是19世纪被复制最多的画家之一，在1870年至1939年间大量产出赝品。仅在1888年，一家比利时工作室就制造了235幅柯罗的假风景画。即便如此，于格的数字还是被夸大了，欧洲的柯罗赝品与美国的一样多（在20世纪初进入博物馆收藏，包括卢浮宫）。柯罗的成功，尤其是在他晚年，激发了其他艺术家造假的灵感。这位艺术家对造假也采取了宽容的态度，有时会在赝品上做最后的修饰，并把它们当成自己的作品蒙混过关。根据一则轶事，一个男人向这位艺术家展示了他刚买的一些柯罗的小幅画布，柯罗对此回应道：“你怎么见鬼地认为我画了这种可怕的东西？你居然还为这些付了钱？”然后这个人告诉他自己付了多少钱；柯罗对他心生怜悯，提出帮他修补，并在第二天修饰了这幅画，将其变成了一幅“真品”柯罗。", "奥诺雷·杜米埃（1808–79）图片来源：俄克拉荷马城艺术博物馆藏品。摄影：Shannon Kolvitz。https://www.intenttodeceive.org/ 当一位策展人在费城艺术博物馆筹备1937年奥诺雷·杜米埃作品展时，他很难找到绝对真品。展览开幕前后《时代》杂志发表的一篇文章感叹道：“与其他任何伟大的19世纪法国艺术家相比，杜米埃被模仿、伪造和糟蹋得最多。”为了只呈现真正的杜米埃作品，展览图录中包含了技术注释，描述了对某些作品进行的X光和红外线照片研究。对于这位多产的法国艺术家和漫画家来说，只有在他生前及其授权出版商印制的版画才被认为是原作；所有其他作品皆为赝品。根据该艺术家的数字作品全集《杜米埃登记册》，杜米埃总共创作了1,340幅素描，但另有1,562幅素描被指定为“仿杜米埃作”和“未确认”。他的油画作品则更不平衡，登记册称他创作了283幅画作，但另有609幅作品据称为该艺术家所作。登记册指出：“甚至无法计算伪造的石版画或重印版画的数量。这对艺术家杜米埃来说是一个巨大的赞誉，他生前就已经抱怨过他的许多作品被伪造了。”", Kisling）在该艺术家死后完成了他的一些未竟之作。无论真假，赝品在该艺术家于1920年35岁英年早逝后便立即涌现，并一直持续至今。情况极端到2017年热那亚总督宫（Palazzo Ducale）的一场莫迪利安尼展览因三分之一的作品被意大利警方以涉嫌造假为由扣押而戛然而止。那么，拍卖行或画廊该怎么办？许多机构要求莫迪利安尼的作品必须被收录在艺术评论家安布罗焦·切罗尼（Ambrogio Ceroni）的作品全集中（该全集首次出版于1958年并于1970年更新，共收录337件作品，但不包括切罗尼未亲自见过的作品，例如在美国的作品）。然而，莫迪利安尼的研究一直在变化。就在去年，由马克·雷斯特利尼（Marc Restellini）长期筹备的作品全集在经历诉讼后终于出版，非营利组织莫迪利安尼倡议会（Modigliani Initiative）也发布了公开的在线全集。", "links": "乔治·德·基里科（1888–1978）图片来源：佳士得。艺术家被他人仿冒是一回事，而艺术家自己伪造自己则是完全不同的情况。乔治·德·基里科（Giorgio de Chirico）的超现实情况正是如此。他早期那些如梦似幻、令人毛骨悚然的远景作品即他的“形而上学风格”，即便在他转向收藏家认为不那么抢全新古典主义技法（包括马匹和身穿盔甲的骑士等主题）创作之后，依然备受欢迎。基里科历来是个现实主义者，他退而求其次，开始自己复制早期（且商业上更成功）的作品，这本身其实算不上什么大问题——除了他还给这些作品倒填了日期。他将这些作品称为 verifalsi，意为“真伪之作”（true-fakes），鉴于原作是他的知识产权，他并不觉得这有什么问题。1919年，超现实主义收藏家西蒙娜·科利内（Simone Collinet）询问是否可以买下一件他已经售出的作品时，基里科就曾模仿过自己的一幅画作；为了取悦她，他画了相同的东西。几年后的1924年，基里科为保尔·艾略特（Paul Éluard）及其妻子加拉（Gala）复制了他由艺术史学家乔治·卡斯特尔弗朗哥（Giorgio Castelfranco）收藏的画作《不安的缪斯》（Le muse inquietanti，1918）。此后他还画了更多此类作品。更复杂的是，自己伪造自己的并非基里科一人。一些超现实主义者，例如奥斯卡·多明格斯（Óscar Domínguez）、马克斯·恩斯特（Max Ernst）和雷梅迪奥斯·瓦罗（Remedios Varo），据称也创作过德·基里科的复制品。其他人亦是如此。这位艺术家开始亲自整顿自己的市场，公开斥责造假行为。据《时代》杂志1961年的一篇文章报道，一位米兰艺术评论家曾说：“他没收的画作中有百分之六十确实是赝品。百分之三十是他自己画的，还有百分之十也是他自己画的，但他自己给忘了。”", "links": [{"text": "many 对于安迪·沃霍尔这样经常被伪造、且其创作本就带有玩味“原创性”之意的艺术家而言，这个问题就变得更为棘手了。作为量产美学的泰斗，沃霍尔采用了一种相对容易复制的流行丝网印刷技术。据沃霍尔专家理查德·波尔斯基（Richard Polsky）所说，辨别一件作品是否为沃霍尔赝品有几个蛛丝马迹。首先，沃霍尔丝网印刷品上的油墨并不是完全均匀的——有些地方墨迹过重，有些地方则过轻——因此缺乏这种变化的版画可能会有问题。此外，还要对任何处于全新状态（mint condition）的作品保持警惕，这可能暗示该作品是由印刷厂重新过筛制成的。沃霍尔的玛丽莲·梦露作品是他最常被赝品化的作品之一，一个明显的破绽是用手绘斜线来区分版画编号和版数（造假者通常会弄错）。除了玛丽莲系列，沃霍尔其他常被仿冒的作品还有花卉、毛泽东像和电椅。在他前波普时期的作品中，沃霍尔的鞋子和猫的画作在造假者中很受欢迎。2021年，布鲁克林的艺术集体 MSCHF 买下了一张价值20K美元的沃霍尔画作《Fairies》（1954），并制作了999件一模一样的复制品。肇事者销毁了辨别真迹的记录，将真品沃霍尔与打乱后的批次混在一起，每张画以250美元的价格出售。“大写A的艺术世界对真实性的关注远胜于美学，”该集体写道。“通过大规模伪造《Fairies》，我们抹去了该艺术品的流传有序轨迹。尽管它在物理上完好无损，但我们摧毁了人们对该作品真实性的未来所有信心。通过在针堆里藏一根针，我们让原作变得和我们的任何复制品一样都是赝品。”", article_text:
What makes an artwork real? This seemingly straightforward question can actually be quite loaded.

A faked artwork is generally considered to be a copy of an existing work. This seems clear enough, but what about when an artist copies his or her own work? A forgery, on the other hand, imitates an artist’s style to create a new work. But what if the forged artist was someone who challenged concepts of artistic originality and appropriated images from others?

Art trickery can get tricky. And yet it persists. Some experts estimate that around half of the secondary art market consists of forgeries and misattributions. Certain inauthentic works—made by infamous forgers such as Han van Meegeren (who made bogus Vermeers) and Wolfgang Beltracchi (responsible for hundreds of phony works)—are prized for their novelty and tales of exposure. Other times, artworks can initially be written off as forgeries but later identified as genuine through scientific analysis.

Museums are not impervious to these phenomena. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, for example, has a 1624 portrait of Spain’s King Philip IV that it deemed in the 1970s to have been created by an assistant to Diego Velázquez, only to reauthenticate it fully to the Spanish Baroque painter in 2010.

When in doubt, experts lean on the three-legged stool of art authentication: stylistic scrutiny, provenance, and scientific analysis. (The Velázquez reattribution was thanks to the latter, after varnish removal.)

In a comprehensive 1963 book titled Forgeries, Fakes, and Reproductions , author George Savage writes at the close of the preface that “the collector may take heart from the fact that at no time during the history of the art-market has forgery been so difficult as it is now, or more likely to be detected, and the forger’s task is becoming continually more difficult.” Be that as it may, it doesn’t appear that forgers have stopped in the decades since.

Below are nine of the most faked and forged artists.

Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot (1796–1875) Image Credit: Collection of the University of Delaware. https://exhibitions.lib.udel.edu/things-arent-what-they-seem/home/art-forgery/ There’s a famous quip about French painter Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot from art historian René Huyghe, who claimed that “Corot painted three thousand canvases, ten thousand of which have been sold in America.” Corot was one of the most copied 19th-century painters, with fakes produced abundantly between 1870 and 1939. A single Belgian studio manufactured 235 fake Corot landscapes in 1888 alone. Even so, Huyghe’s number is exaggerated, and there are as many fake Corots in Europe as there are in the United States (entering museum collections in the early 20th century, including the Louvre’s). Corot’s success, especially in his later years, inspired other artists to forge his work. The artist also had a lax attitude toward forgeries. sometimes adding finishing touches to fakes and passing them off as his own. According to one anecdote, a man showed the artist some small Corot canvases that he had just bought, to which Corot replied, “How the devil can you think I painted such horrors? And you actually paid money for these?” The man then told him how much he’d paid; taking pity on him, Corot offered to fix it and touched up the painting by the next day, turning it into an “authentic” Corot.

Honoré Daumier (1808–79) Image Credit: Collection of the Oklahoma City Museum of Art. Photo: Shannon Kolvitz. https://www.intenttodeceive.org/ When a curator was preparing a 1937 exhibition of HonoréDaumier works at the Philadelphia Museum of Art, he struggled to find pieces that were absolutely authentic. An article published in Time magazine around the time of the exhibition opening lamented that “more than any other great 19th century French artist, Daumier has been imitated, forged and mistreated.” Dedicated to presenting only real deal Daumiers, the exhibition catalogue included technical notes describing the X-ray and infrared photo studies done for certain works. In the case of the prolific French artist and caricaturist, only prints produced in his lifetime and by his authorized publisher are considered originals; all others are fakes. According to the Daumier Register, a digital catalogue raisonné for the artist, Daumier created 1,340 drawings in total, but there are another 1,562 drawings designated as “after Daumier” and “unconfirmed.” His oil paintings are even more off balance, with the Register claiming that he created 283 paintings but that 609 additional works are purported to be by the artist. “It is not even possible to calculate the number of forged lithographs or reprints,” notes the Register. “This is a great compliment to the artist Daumier, who already complained during his lifetime that many of his works were forged.”

Auguste Rodin (1840–1917) Image Credit: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York. https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/339725 French sculptor Auguste Rodin has been forged so often that some of his forgers are known by name. Among these is Odilon Roche, who collected drawings by the artist. Another prolific forger was Ernest Durig, who claimed to be Rodin’s last student and sold his forged drawings under the pretense that they were gifts from the master (including one that made it into the collection of the Metropolitan Museum of Art). Nine fakes by Durig were included in a traveling 1971-72 exhibition titled “Roding Drawings: True and False,” which showed at Washington’s National Gallery of Art and then moved to the Solomon R. Guggenheim Mseum in New York. It included 132 Rodin drawings alongside 28 forgeries of his work, and a “true and false” section where viewers were challenged to look at 30 unlabeled pieces and see if they could determine what was what. Rodin’s bronze sculptures are also catnip for forgers. Posthumous bronze “originals” have repeatedly been cast from the artist’s plaster models, often lacking clear markings that they are reproductions. In 2019, for example, the Musée Rodin (which holds the rights to the artist’s works) pressed charges against Parisian art dealer Robert Crouzet and American art dealer Gary Snell; Crouzet sold 16 Rodin models to Snell, who proceeded to cast around 1,700 works that weren’t marked as reproductions. Some of Snell’s casts even bore Rodin’s signature and the Fonderie Rudier foundry mark (instead of the mark of the foundry where they were actually made).

Frederic Remington (1861–1909) Image Credit: Frederic Remington catalogue raisonné, Buffalo Bill Center of the West, Cody, Wyoming. https://centerofthewest.org/2018/12/21/points-west-finding-real-frederic-remington/ Hailed in his lifetime as the “pictorial historian of the Great West,” Frederic Remington is among the most copied, faked, and forged American artists. His paintings and illustrations were featured often in popular magazines, which boosted their popularity and rendered them copyable. A large-scale Remington exhibition at the Buffalo Bill Historical Center in Cody, Wyoming, was the catalyst for a catalogue raisonné, and between 1985 and 1996 the museum formalized an authentication process for Remington works. The artworks had to be inspected at the museum, and so 248 works were reviewed for the eventual two-volume catalogue. Of those 248, only 53 were deemed authentic (roughly 20 percent, a proportion that has remained consistent in ongoing authentication reviews since). The review committee categorized four types of inauthentic works: pastiches, copies, fakes, and forgeries. Pastiches (the smallest category) are intended to deceive; they copy parts of multiple Remington artworks with the addition of a faux signature. Copies could be unsigned, are the most prevalent, and presumably could have been painted as an artistic exercise. Fakes account for almost a quarter of the inauthentic works submitted for certification and consist of fraudulently signed paintings or drawings unrelated to known Remingtons but of a subject that interested the artist. A forgery is a work by another artist whose name has been removed or covered and replaced with an inauthentic Remington signature.

Amedeo Modigliani (1884–1920) Image Credit: Scott and Pamela Richter. https://www.intenttodeceive.org/ The former global director of Art Basel, Marc Spiegler, once quoted a Parisian dealer as saying: “The drama here is that I could find a Modigliani in an attic tomorrow, with a letter from Modigliani attached to it, and people would still hesitate.” The hesitation is warranted—given the drama surrounding the modernist painter’s forgery market and the unsettled state of Modigliani scholarship and his catalogue raisonné. Modigliani gave away many drawings, making provenance hard to track. His lack of a firm paper archive makes it easier to try to slip new works into his oeuvre. Some believe that fellow artist and close friend Moïse Kisling completed some of Modigliani’s unfinished works after the latter’s death. Whether or not that is true, fakes started emerging right after the artist’s premature death at age 35 in 1920 and have persisted ever since. The situation is so extreme that in 2017 a Modigliani exhibition at Genoa’s Palazzo Ducale ended abruptly when one-third of the works were seized by the Italian police on suspicion of being phony. So what’s an auction house or gallery to do? Many require that a Modigliani be included in art critic Ambrogio Ceroni’s catalogue raisonné, first published in 1958 and updated in 1970, which lists 337 works but does not include pieces Ceroni didn’t see in person (such as those in the United States). Modigliani scholarship, however, is changing all the time. Just this past year, a long-anticipated catalogue raisonné by Marc Restellini was published (following lawsuits) and a public online catalogue was released by the nonprofit Modigliani Initiative.

Giorgio de Chirico (1888–1978) Image Credit: Christie’s. It’s one thing when artists are forged by others, and another thing entirely when artists forge themselves. Such is the surreal case of Giorgio de Chirico. His early works of dreamlike, eerie vistas, his “metaphysical style,” remained highly popular even after he moved on to painting in a neoclassical technique that collectors found less desirable (including subjects such as horses and knights in armor). Ever the pragmatist, de Chirico retreated to duplicating his earlier (and more his commercially successful) works himself, which wouldn’t be entirely problematic in and of itself—except he also backdated them. He dubbed them verifalsi , meaning “true-fakes,” and didn’t see an issue since the originals were his intellectual property. In one instance, in 1919, de Chirico imitated one of his own paintings after Surrealist collector Simone Collinet asked if she could buy a work that he had already sold; he painted the same thing to please her. A few years later, in 1924, de Chirico copied his painting Le muse inquietanti (1918), which was owned by art historian Giorgio Castelfranco, for Paul Éluard and his wife, Gala. He would go on to paint many more . Complicating matters, de Chirico wasn’t the only one forging himself. Some Surrealists, such as Óscar Domínguez, Max Ernst, and Remedios Varo, allegedly created de Chirico replicas. So did others. The artist took to policing his own market, publicly calling out forgeries. According to a 1961 article in Time , a Milanese art critic said that “sixty percent of the paintings he sequesters are really fakes. Thirty percent he painted himself, and ten percent he painted himself but has forgotten about it.”

Salvador Dalí (1904–89) Image Credit: Yves Gellie/Gamma-Rapho via Getty Images. The artist who famously melted clocks and bent reality also played with authenticity, signing thousands of blank sheets of paper for publishers to use later for limited-edition prints. Unsurprisingly, many of these sheets were misused. (According to Dalí’s secretary, John Peter Moore, the artist signed around 350,000 blank sheets of paper over the course of his career.) Provenance standards are looser with prints since they exist in multiples, making them easier to forge, but there have been instances where even Dalí’s pre-signed papers were forged. As a result, the artist’s print market is riddled with fakes. Forgeries are often exposed when they go on display at prominent museums. In 2025, Italian art police seized 21 Dalí artworks from the exhibition “Dali: Between Art and Myth,” at Palazzo Tarasconi in Parma, claiming that they were forged. According to art fraud investigator Colette Loll, the incident was the third major seizure by the carabinieri of Dalí works.

Andy Warhol (1928–87) Image Credit: MSCHF. https://moforgeries.org/ The subject gets trickier with artists such as the frequently forged Andy Warhol, who intentionally played with issues of originality. A master of the mass-produced look, Warhol used a popular photo-silkscreen technique that is relatively easy to duplicate. According to Warhol expert Richard Polsky, there are a few telltale clues that a work might be a fake Warhol. For one thing, the ink on Warhol’s silkscreens wasn’t perfectly uniform—in some places too heavy on the ink, in others too light—so prints lacking this variation might be off. Also be wary of anything in mint condition, a possible indication that a work was re-screened by a print shop. Warhol’s Marilyn Monroe works are among his most commonly faked, a telling giveaway being the hand-drawn slash used to differentiate between the print number and the edition size (which forgers usually get wrong). Besides the Marilyns, other commonly counterfeited Warhols are the Flowers, Maos, and Electric Chairs. Of his pre-Pop works, Warhol’s drawings of shoes and cats are popular among forgers. In 2021, the Brooklyn-based art collective MSCHF bought a $20K Warhol drawing, Fairies (1954), and created 999 identical copies. Destroying the record that identified the original, the perpetrators mixed in the real Warhol with the shuffled lot and the drawings were sold for $250 each . “The capital-A Art World is far more concerned with authenticity than aesthetics,” the collective wrote. “By forging Fairies en masse, we obliterate the trail of provenance for the artwork. Though physically undamaged, we destroy any future confidence in the veracity of the work. By burying a needle in a needlestack, we render the original as much a forgery as any of our replications.”

Jean-Michel Basquiat (1960–88) Image Credit: TNS/Getty Images. Works by American artist Jean-Michel Basquiat have been sought after since his heyday in the 1980s, but a steady stream of fakes cropped up after one of his paintings sold for $110.5 million at a 2017 sale at Sotheby’s New York. Just five years after that, a 2022 Basquiat exhibition at the Orlando Museum of Art was shuttered prematurely when FBI agents seized all 25 artworks on view, on the grounds that they were part of a fraud and conspiracy. ( The museum’s director was fired , and the FBI later announced that someone had confessed to forging most of the pieces.) According to Richard Polsky, who authenticates Basquiats, there are a few hints that a Basquiat may be a fake. Forgers tend to include gold crowns and prominently sign works on the front or the verso (even though Basquiat never signed his works on the front, and many are unsigned). Paintings on found objects, or works that have an incredible backstory (one that conveniently explains the lack of a paper trail for the work) are also frequent offenders. Unlike earlier artists, whose forgeries can be identified through scientific testing of materials, this part of the three-legged authentication stool isn’t helpful in weeding out fake Basquiats since the materials he used are still widely available.

article_text:
Le lait de l’oranger de Gisèle Halimi (Gallimard) [livre]

Dans ce récit où s’entrelacent histoire intime et histoire collective – de la guerre d’Algérie aux combats pour les droits des femmes –, Gisèle Halimi revient sur son parcours d’émancipation, de ses premières révoltes d’enfant à ses grands combats médiatisés d’avocate accomplie. Parue en 1988, son autobiographie prend la forme d’une lettre pleine de tendresse adressée à son père, Édouard. Elle y évoque notamment la petite fille qui, pour échapper au café au lait du matin, en vidait le contenu au pied de l’oranger du jardin ; ou celle qui entama une grève de la faim pour ne plus avoir à servir ses frères, résistant même aux makrouts de sa grand-mère.

Le lait de l’oranger , livre

Gisèle Halimi, la fauteuse de troubles (Les Grandes Traversées sur France Culture) [podcast] Ilana Navaro compose un portrait vivant de Gisèle Halimi, nourri d’archives sonores et de témoignages. Parmi les intervenants, on retrouve son fils, Jean-Yves Halimi, l’historienne Michelle Perrot et Sophia Khali, petite-fille de Djamila Boupacha, militante indépendantiste algérienne qui avait accusé des militaires français de l’avoir torturée et violée pendant sa détention, et dont Gisèle Halimi avait assuré la défense.

Gisèle Halimi, la fauteuse de troubles , sur France Culture

Gisèle Halimi. Une farouche liberté [livre et spectacle]

Bien plus qu’un récit biographique, cette pièce de théâtre inspirée du livre d’entretiens entre la célèbre avocate et la journaliste Annick Cojean, Une farouche liberté, nous plonge dans les combats de Gisèle Halimi. Dans une mise en scène épurée, Lena Paugam fait dialoguer les différents visages et âges de Gisèle Halimi : la rebelle, l’amoureuse, l’enragée, la combattante décoloniale. Sur scène : les complices Marie-Christine Barrault et Hinda Abdelaoui. Le spectacle est en tournée en France à partir de janvier 2027.

Une Farouche liberté, livre et spectacle

Niquer la fatalité d’Estelle Meyer [spectacle] Comment échapper à son destin de femme, celui dicté par le corps, la famille, la société ? C’est l’obsession de ce spectacle fou, transdisciplinaire, dans lequel Estelle Meyer convoque l’esprit, les doutes et les combats de Gisèle Halimi, pour éclairer sa propre trajectoire. Des règles douloureuses aux injustices de genre, en passant par le désir réprimé, Estelle Meyer chante, danse la désobéissance et la réappropriation de soi. Indispensable et réjouissant. Dates à préciser.

Niquer la fatalité , spectacle

Archive INA / Emission L’Invité du jeudi, Gisèle Halimi, Anne Sinclair, Antenne 2, 22 novembre 1979 [vidéo] En novembre 1979, Anne Sinclair reçoit Gisèle Halimi sur Antenne 2. L’avocate revient sur ses combats pour le droit à l’avortement et contre le viol, mais aussi sur les liens entre émancipation des femmes et lutte des classes. Elle évoque notamment les Assises de la paix à l’UNESCO, où les femmes ne représentent que six participants sur soixante-dix. Un entretien de plus d’une heure, qui donne à voir l’ampleur politique et internationale de son engagement.

article_text:
写真家・相澤有紀が、新たなZINEシリーズ「MONOCHROMES」を創刊する。これを記念した展覧会「MONOCHROMES Launch Exhibition」が、2026年10月16日から18日まで、東京・世田谷区代沢のフリースペースDoeで開催される。

「MONOCHROMES」は、相澤が旅や日々の生活のなかで撮影した写真をまとめていくモノクロフィルムの写真集シリーズ。季節ごとに編み、年間4冊の発行を予定している。今回の創刊では「ISSUE FOR SUMMER 2025」と「Vol.01 ISSUE FOR WINTER 2025」の2冊を発表する。

相澤は、2023年に写真集「TOKYO MONOCHROMES」を刊行後、約2年間メルボルンに滞在。今回発表する夏号は、帰国前のメルボルンでの日々や、ヨーロッパを旅するなかで撮影した写真を中心に構成される。制作の軸となるのは、モノクロームによって日常のなかの光を捉えることだ。相澤はこれまで、目の前の光景に現れる模様や形状を見つめながら撮影を続けてきた。「MONOCHROMES」でもその視点を引き継ぎつつ、旅先や日常で出会う光景を季節ごとに編み直し、時間の蓄積を一冊のZINEへと定着させていく。

ローンチ展では、2冊のZINEの販売とモノクロプリントを展示。あわせて、新作「TOKYO MONOCHROMES」のデザインも手がけたMikuto MurayamaによるデザインのスクリーンプリントTシャツも販売する。

相澤は1990年、東京都生まれ。写真家、アーティスト写真やアルバムジャケット、ファッション、広告などの撮影を手がける一方、旅や日々の生活のなかで撮影を続けている。2023年に写真集「TOKYO MONOCHROMES」を刊行し、同年より約2年間メルボルンに滞在。写真集やZINE、展示を通して作品を発表している。

title_original: Will ‘You Can See Everything’ Catch ‘Fahrenheit 9/11’ to Be the Highest-Grossing Documentary Ever?
editorial_title_zh: 《You Can See Everything》能否赶超《华氏9/11》成为有史以来票房最高的纪录片？

article_text:
It’s too early to say if Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s “ You Can See Everything ” will win Oscars or have a direct impact on history as it pertains to Elizabeth Holmes and Theranos, but it does feel like a movie that journalists are going to be referencing for a long time as a significant benchmark for documentary films at the box office .

Currently sitting at $45.1 million domestic , with no international release to speak of yet, A24’s film is already one of the highest-grossing documentaries ever. Domestically (not factoring inflation) it has already placed firmly within the top 10 and has obliterated films like “Free Solo” ($17.5 million), “Won’t You Be My Neighbor” ($22.8 million), and “An Inconvenient Truth” ($24.1 million). It has surpassed some big nature docs like “Earth,” “Chimpanzee,” and lags only “March of the Penguins” ($77.4 million), and it has surpassed concert docs like “Katy Perry: Part of Me” ($25.3 million) and “One Direction: This Is Us” ($28.8 million) but lags the Michael Jackson doc “This Is It” ($72 million) and “Justin Bieber: Never Say Never” ($73 million).

If we want to put a bunch of really dumb caveats and qualifiers on it, “You Can See Everything” is already domestically the highest-grossing non-concert, non-political, non-nature docs ever made, a made-up distinction previously held, by my count, by “Won’t You Be My Neighbor?” (sorry Mister Rogers).

But even if it passes all those other movies, it might still fall short of the documentary that remains far and away the biggest box office hit for a doc ever, Michael Moore ‘s 2004 film “Fahrenheit 9/11,” Moore’s scathing takedown of President Bush and the Iraq War as released in the heat of a massive election year.

Moore’s film did not win the Oscar (though it did win the Palme D’Or at Cannes) because it was ineligible after airing on TV ahead of the election, and it did not prevent George W. Bush from being re-elected to a second term, and it probably isn’t even Moore’s best film. But it’s worth remembering just how seismic an event the film was upon its release, not unlike the stir that initial cryptic, meme-worthy teaser of Fielder and Holmes was.

Moore was already a firebrand with instant name recognition thanks to “Bowling for Columbine,” which was previously among the highest-grossing documentaries ever. But “Fahrenheit 9/11” carried with it even more publicity and attention, including because of the fight to get it to screens in the first place. Disney famously blocked Harvey and Bob Weinstein’s Miramax from releasing “Fahrenheit 9/11,” leading the Weinsteins to buy the film back and then partner with Lions Gate and IFC Films to get the movie into theaters. It even had to do so within an incredibly quick turnaround time of 24 days to get prints made and get the film delivered to theaters . Even then, Lions Gate co-president Tom Ortenberg was predicting that the film was going to disrupt distribution and set the record as the biggest documentary ever.

He was right. “Fahrenheit 9/11” opened on just 868 screens on June 25, but it was the No. 1 movie in America with $23.9 million, beating out other new releases like “White Chicks” and “The Notebook.” “You Can See Everything” opened to a similar number of theaters but made only $15.6 million in that first weekend. By July 4 weekend it had expanded to nearly double the theaters and made another $22 million, and by its fifth weekend was over $100 million. The film ultimately played in theaters for 15 weeks into October ahead of the election. Domestically, it made $119.1 million and even made an additional $103 million abroad to bring its worldwide total to $222.4 million. “This Is It” actually has the edge worldwide with $267.9 million, but the bulk of that came from overseas audiences.

The film sparked serious headlines about whether it would damage Bush in the election, and it was a big enough media sensation that “Fahrenheit 451” author Ray Bradbury lashed out at Moore as a “jerk.” Other filmmakers had released parody documentaries against Moore, and it earned sharp criticisms from political pundits disputing its accuracy. Moore’s follow-up movie “Sicko” received an even larger budget of $9 million from the Weinsteins, and it too grossed above “Bowling for Columbine” with $24.5 million domestic.

Clearly the conditions under which documentaries are released in theaters have changed drastically since “Fahrenheit 9/11.” Such a film would most likely today open on streaming, and in today’s hyper-polarized political climate, might struggle to be platformed by gun-shy distributors and streamers. And the market for all documentaries in theaters has fallen drastically in the post-Covid era. “Melania” was previously the highest-grossing doc of 2026 with $16.6 million domestic , but that one is an outlier for a number of reasons.

For “You Can See Everything” to catch “Fahrenheit 9/11,” it would have to put up “Obsession” levels of word of mouth , continually notching up at the box office this coming weekend as it continues to add screens, and the film already tripled its screen count in Weekend 2. But a long theatrical run and an awards push could realistically get it into the 70s and help it push for the Top 5 among docs.

You can see everything, yes, but even we didn’t necessarily see that one coming.

article_text:
Source: A24

‘The Invite’

The Invite , All Of A Sudden , Clarissa , La Gradiva and Tender Loving Care lead the way on four nominations each for the 36th edition of the Gotham Film Awards.

Last year, the Gotham Film & Media Institute expanded the best feature category from five to 10 slots and the nominees include Club Kid , The Debut , Teenage Sex And Death At Camp Miasma and Paper Tiger.

Best international feature nominees include Fatherland , La Gradiva , Possible Love , Minotaur , All Of A Sudden and Tender Loving Care.

Andrew Scott for Elsinore , Jeon Do-yeon for Possible Love , John Malkovich for Wild Horse Nine , Mahershala Ali for Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother , Julianne Moore for The Debut and Sophie Okonedo for Clarissa are among the lead performance nominees.

Sandra Hüller garnered a supporting performance nod for Fatherland and goes against Tom Courtenay for Queen At Sea , Penélope Cruz for The Invite and Kate O’Flynn for Tender Loving Care, among other nominees.

Three years ago the Gothams removed the $35m budget cap on submissions. Netflix’s La Bola Negra , Possible Love , Ink and Gentle Monster were ineligible for best feature under the category rules, and The Mis-Adventures Of Cliff Booth was not submitted for consideration before the deadline.

However, La Bola Negra did earn two nominations as Guitarricadelafuente was recognised in the breakthrough performance category and the film is in the running for the audience award, which returns after an absence of several years, alongside the likes of Obsession and Michael . You Can See Everything is in contention for the audience award and best documentary.

The 36th Annual Gotham Film Awards will take place in New York on November 30. Last season One Battle After Another won a sole award for best feature and Jafar Panahi was the star of the ceremony, taking awards for director, screenplay and international feature. Akinola Davies Jr. won best breakthrough director for My Father’s Shadow.

The show tells the heroic tales of an FBI agent whose alleged career intersects with major events in American history. Cold, antiseptic photographs encased neatly in plexiglass make up a detective story linking the protagonist to the explosion of TWA Flight 800, the 9/11 attacks, the bombing of the United States embassy in Nairobi, Bill Clinton’s impeachment, and more. Trudging up the Guggenheim’s spiraling galleries, I wonder whether this patriotic show is organized and sponsored by the US State Department. Simon makes you read a lot, but all that reading is just meant to distract you from thinking."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Jodie Foster narrates the audio guide for those who don’t have the patience to read long-winded wall texts. article_text:
Weekly Newsletter

Please Don’t Sit on the Flowers

Long-lost Georgia O’Keeffe landscape goes to auction, Brancusi gets lost at MoMA, interview with Doris Salcedo, and is showing at documenta worth it?

Sitting at September Cafe, I watch the autumn leaves separate from the trees and get carried away gently by the wind. They swirl and twirl, performing a merry little dance in the air before falling to their final resting place.

News has just come in about a sweeping Democratic victory in the midterm elections, as fierce and awesome as a Gustave Courbet wave. But I see nobody popping champagne bottles in the streets. A pregnant black cat with a hanging belly saunters by.

Lying back in the dentist’s chair, a TV screen in front of me shuffles picturesque views from exotic places. They're idyllic to the point of not looking real. My doctor, a Lebanese, shows me an X-ray of my mouth, which looks like Beirut at the height of the Civil War.

The sky over the Robert F. Kennedy Bridge is gray, and the Harlem River is brooding as I make my way to Taryn Simon’s exhibition Father Country I Do Love You at the Guggenheim Museum. The show tells the heroic tales of an FBI agent whose alleged career intersects with major events in American history. Cold, antiseptic photographs encased neatly in plexiglass make up a detective story linking the protagonist to the explosion of TWA Flight 800, the 9/11 attacks, the bombing of the United States embassy in Nairobi, Bill Clinton’s impeachment, and more. Trudging up the Guggenheim’s spiraling galleries, I wonder whether this patriotic show is organized and sponsored by the US State Department. Simon makes you read a lot, but all that reading is just meant to distract you from thinking.

Jodie Foster narrates the audio guide for those who don’t have the patience to read long-winded wall texts. At the cafeteria, while eating a bikini sandwich, I see a woman who looks exactly like Judi Dench, another actress. “I love storytelling,” she tells a friend before plunging her teeth into a chocolate croissant.

On my way out, I once again resent how this museum forces everyone to exit through the gift shop to encourage commerce, but I buy myself a $5 Guggenheim bag anyway. Outside, in one of the manicured gardens of the Upper East Side, a small sign pleads, “Please don’t sit on the flowers.”

I cross the street into Central Park through Engineers’ Gate, climb the steps past a gilded bust of John Purroy Mitchel, NYC mayor between 1914-1918, and look out over the Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis Reservoir. I think of the Kennedys, of Trump, and of Simon. A worker collects brown leaves in plastic bags and tosses them into a truck wrapped in a photo of green leaves. A mother tries to snap a photo of her child, but the unruly kid refuses to pose for the camera. He throws a fit, falls, and, to her shock, ends up sitting on the flowers.

—Hakim Bishara, editor-in-chief

So You’ve Been Invited to Documenta 16. Here’s Our Advice.

Over the past few months, several artist friends who have been invited to participate in the upcoming documenta 16 have contacted us for advice, asking whether they should accept, refuse early on, or accept for now and withdraw at a later stage. As two artists who participated in documenta 15, we understand the dilemma. An invitation to documenta is not something one receives thoughtlessly. It is hard to turn down, and these days, it is also becoming hard to accept. | Anonymous Documenta 15 Artists

Read More

Sarah Sze: Images in Translation at the Yale University Art Gallery

Step into Sarah Sze’s world, where painting and sculpture collide with photography, printmaking, video, and installation. This immersive exhibition pulls viewers into the mind’s eye of the artist and her processes of image making, inviting you to consider the fleeting nature of imagery and art making in our media-saturated society.

Learn more

News

Georgia O’Keeffe’s long-lost painting “Near Abiquiu, New Mexico I” was stashed in an East Village closet for decades. Now it might sell for up to $3 million .

Daniel Sikkema is sentenced to life in prison for his role in the murder-for-hire of his estranged husband, New York art dealer Brent Sikkema.

The Met Gala’s new theme has been announced . Brace yourself for A-listers strutting down the red carpet in everyday garb like jeans, T-shirts, and “humble, even ‘disposable’ materials.”

With less than a month left until the 61st Venice Biennale closes, the United States pavilion commissioner Jenni Parido pleads for additional donations to ship Alma Allen’s sculptures out of Italy .

Leaders at Manhattan’s Museum of Modern Art, Paris’s Centre Pompidou, and M+ in Hong Kong sign an agreement granting unprecedented access to each museum’s holdings .

A group representing over a quarter of Art Basel Paris’s exhibitors release a letter demanding compensation following the fair’s abrupt closure.

The Weisman Art Museum at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities appoints established curator, arts writer, and Hyperallergic contributor Elliot Josephine Leila Reichert as its new senior curator.

Visitors to the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston can soon watch the year-long restoration process of Nicolaes Eliasz Pickenoy’s “The Founders of the Amsterdam Wine Merchants Guild” (1625).

Pace Gallery is struggling, Ebony L. Haynes joins Marian Goodman Gallery, longtime Manifesta director steps down, and more in Art Movements .

解説・あらすじ

古くから牛と人が強い絆で結ばれてきた中国山地を舞台に、近代化と過疎化のなかで失われゆく生活文化史を記録したドキュメンタリー。 中国山地各地では、昭和30年代まで「牛馬市」という競り市が開かれていた。特に島根県邑南町では、出羽・亀谷・阿須那などで大規模な牛馬市が開かれ、昭和の最盛期には出羽牛馬市に8000頭以上もの牛馬が、博労と呼ばれる家畜商に連れられて集まったという。市には露天商やサーカスなどの催しも出されたことから多くの人々で賑わい、地元の農家や住民が牛馬宿をしつらえるなど、地域経済を支える一大産業となった。農業の近代化以前、牛は農耕や荷役を担う重要な労働力であり、家族同様に大切にされていた。しかし近年では過疎化が進み、各地で伝承されてきた地域の生活文化や精神文化は消滅しつつある。牛によってもたらされた豊かな生活文化のありようが見えにくくなった現在、残り少ない伝承者の人々と向き合い映像を記録することが緊急課題となっている。 監督は、「タケヤネの里」「藝州かやぶき紀行」などのドキュメンタリー映画作家・青原さとし。島根県邑南町をはじめ、広島県、岡山県、鳥取県などで5年の歳月をかけて撮影をおこない、牛とともに生きてきた人々の想いを記録していく。

article_text:
The Cinema Eye Honors , one of the main bellwethers for the Best Documentary Feature race, began its 20th annual celebrations with a first wave of awards announcements for its 2027 ceremony.

17 films made it onto its Audience Choice Prize Longlist, including Sundance breakouts like “American Doctor” and “Once Upon a Time in Harlem” as well as recent box office successes “ The History of Concrete ” and “ You Can See Everything .”

The organization’s Unforgettable Honorees, an award celebrating on-camera collaborators, were also announced with the 2027 winners coming from six films: Dr. Thaer Ahmad, Dr. Mark Perlmutter and Dr. Feroze Sidhwa from “American Doctor,” E. Jean Carroll from “Ask E. Jean,” Soraya Akhlaghi from “A Fox Under a Pink Moon,” Billie Jean King from “Give Me the Ball,” Israa from “One in a Million,” and Amy Goodman from “Steal This Story, Please!”

On the Broadcast side, nominees were announced for five different categories, from Outstanding Achievement in Broadcast Film to Outstanding Achievement in Broadcast Editing. The annual Shorts List, spotlighting 10 of the year’s top documentary short films, including “They’re Here” co-directed by Oscar winner Laura Poitras, was also part of the announcement.

Finally, “Hoop Dreams,” Steve James’ documentary masterpiece, will receive the Legacy Award, which is presented to a classic nonfiction film that continues to inspire today’s working filmmakers. James will accept the award on behalf of his team members Peter Gilbert (Producer and DP), Frederick Marx (Producer and Editor), Adam Singer (Sound Recordist), Gordon Quinn (Executive Producer and founder of Kartemquin Films), Bill Haugse (Editor), Marcie McCall (Kartemquin) and Ben Sidran (Composer).

Cinema Eye will celebrate its 20th annual Awards Ceremony on Monday, January 11, 2027.

A full list of this year’s Cinema Eye Honors announcements and nominees follows.

editorial_title_zh: 让-弗朗索瓦·卡佐画廊：皮埃尔·雅汉（1909–2003）回顾展
editorial_excerpt_zh: 自2009年起扎根巴黎玛黑区，让-弗朗索瓦·卡佐画廊在大西洋两岸的现代主义大师与战后艺术之间搭建桥梁 […] 这篇文章 让-弗朗索瓦·卡佐画廊：皮埃尔·扬（1909–2003）回顾展 最早出现在 The Eye of…
editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "让-弗朗索瓦·卡佐画廊自2009年起扎根巴黎玛黑区，在大西洋两岸的现代主义大师与战后艺术之间搭建桥梁，同时亦向当代艺术敞开大门。为了首次参加将于2026年11月12日至15在大皇宫举办的巴黎摄影展（Paris Photo），并迎接摄影双百年庆典（2026–2027），该画廊已获得法国文化部对此次周年纪念活动的授牌，将呈献一场致力于人道主义与超现实主义摄影师皮埃尔·雅汉（1909–2003）的回顾展。约四十幅摄影作品涵盖了这位艺术家所使用的不同技术及其各项实验，将引领观众重新发现其作品的多重面貌。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "皮埃尔·雅汉生于1909年，属于这样一代摄影先驱：他们不再将摄影视为一种科学或技术实践，而是将其视为一门充满乐趣与自由的艺术。通过这种方式，他与亨利·卡蒂埃-布列松、曼·雷、李·米勒、拉斯洛·莫霍利-纳吉、朵拉·玛尔以及大西洋彼岸的同仁（如阿尔弗雷德·斯蒂格里茨）一道，共同探求让摄影被认为是一门拥有自身艺术和表现可能性的独立艺术。皮埃尔·雅汉是一位难以归类的先锋派多面手，他将摄影视为试验场，唯一的法则就是眼睛与双手的乐趣。尽管他从未宣称任何教条、始终倾向于保持自由，但奇思妙想依然贯穿其作品的始终。他将生命的冲动与创作的源泉相结合，并毫不犹豫地尝试诸如雷奥格拉夫（rayograph）、摄影拼图（photogram）、多次曝光、蒙太奇和拼贴等新技术。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "1933年定居巴黎后，皮埃尔·雅汉加入了布拉塞、罗贝尔·杜瓦诺和亨利·卡蒂埃-布列松等渴望展现一个全方位、不同面貌之巴黎的摄影师行列。他的影像从植根于现实世界、有时甚至毫不留情的画面（例如他拍摄的占领时期或巴黎解放斗争的照片），转向了他充满想象力的奇幻之作，有时也充满幽默感。皮埃尔·雅汉具有一种罕见的天赋，能够在纪实摄影和超现实主义这两个迥异的世界之间自如游走，尤其是在当时艺术意识形态正以连续宣言的形式激进展开的时期。雅汉的作品不拘一格地横跨了整个20世纪。它时而庄重而富有隐喻，时而漫游而顽皮，始终充盈着抒情主义。这位艺术家实践并将其时代的各种摄影技术推向极致——将其作为真正的试验场——从而创作出既植根于超现实主义又坚定独特的作品。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "让-弗朗索瓦·卡佐画廊回顾展 2026年10月24日 – 12月23日 开幕式：2026年10月23日下午5点至9点 圣阿纳斯塔斯街8号 75003 巴黎 http://www.galeriejfcazeau.com", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "开放时间：星期二至星期六，上午11点至晚上7点", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "巴黎摄影展 2026年11月12日至15日 大皇宫 温斯顿·邱吉尔大道 75008 巴黎", "translated": true}]
article_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "Based in the Marais in Paris since 2009, the Galerie Jean-François Cazeau builds bridges between the Modern Masters and postwar art on both sides of the Atlantic, while also opening itself to contemporary art. For its first participation in Paris Photo, from November 12 to 15, 2026, at the Grand Palais, and in view of the Bicentenaire de la Photographie (2026–2027), the gallery which has received the French Ministry of Culture’s label for this anniversary event will present a retrospective exhibition devoted to the humanist and Surrealist photographer Pierre Jahan (1909–2003). A selection of some forty photographs, illustrating the different techniques the artist used as well as his various experiments, will allow visitors to rediscover the many facets of his work."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Born in 1909, Pierre Jahan belongs to a generation of photographic pioneers who regard the medium no longer as a scientific or technical practice, but as an art of pleasure and freedom. In this way he joins Henri Cartier-Bresson, Man Ray, Lee Miller, László Moholy-Nagy, Dora Maar and their colleagues across the Atlantic, such as Alfred Stieglitz, in the quest to have photography recognized as an art in its own right, endowed with its own artistic and expressive possibilities. Pierre Jahan is a protean figure of the avant-garde, impossible to classify, who considered photography as a testing ground, the only law being the pleasure of the eye and the hand. Although he never claimed any dogma, always preferring to keep his freedom, fantasy nevertheless remained the common thread running through his work. He married the drive of life with its springs of creation and did not hesitate to experiment with new techniques such as the rayograph, the photogram, double exposure, photomontage and photocollage."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Settling permanently in Paris in 1933, Pierre Jahan joined photographers such as Brassaï, Robert Doisneau and Henri Cartier-Bresson, who were eager to show a different Paris, in all its facets. He moved from images rooted in the real world, at times merciless, such as his pictures of the Occupation or of the fight for the Liberation of Paris, to his imaginary fantasies, at times full of humor. Pierre Jahan has the rare talent of slipping seamlessly between the disparate worlds of reportage photography and Surrealism, particularly at a time when artistic ideologies were unfolding militantly in successive manifestos. Jahan’s work crosses the twentieth century at a slant, unconstrained. It is at times grave and metaphorical, at times wandering and playful, always full of lyricism. The artist practices, and pushes to their limits, all the photographic techniques offered by his time a true testing ground – to create a body of work at once rooted in Surrealism and resolutely singular."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Retrospective exhibition at Galerie Jean-François Cazeau October 24 – December 23, 2026 Opening on October 23, 2026, 5–9 pm 8 rue Sainte-Anastase 75003 Paris http://www.galeriejfcazeau.com"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Opening hours Tuesday through Saturday, 11 am–7 pm"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Paris Photo November 12–15, 2026 Grand Palais Avenue Winston Churchill 75008 Paris"}]
article_text:
Based in the Marais in Paris since 2009, the Galerie Jean-François Cazeau builds bridges between the Modern Masters and postwar art on both sides of the Atlantic, while also opening itself to contemporary art. For its first participation in Paris Photo, from November 12 to 15, 2026, at the Grand Palais, and in view of the Bicentenaire de la Photographie (2026–2027), the gallery which has received the French Ministry of Culture’s label for this anniversary event will present a retrospective exhibition devoted to the humanist and Surrealist photographer Pierre Jahan (1909–2003). A selection of some forty photographs, illustrating the different techniques the artist used as well as his various experiments, will allow visitors to rediscover the many facets of his work.

Born in 1909, Pierre Jahan belongs to a generation of photographic pioneers who regard the medium no longer as a scientific or technical practice, but as an art of pleasure and freedom. In this way he joins Henri Cartier-Bresson, Man Ray, Lee Miller, László Moholy-Nagy, Dora Maar and their colleagues across the Atlantic, such as Alfred Stieglitz, in the quest to have photography recognized as an art in its own right, endowed with its own artistic and expressive possibilities. Pierre Jahan is a protean figure of the avant-garde, impossible to classify, who considered photography as a testing ground, the only law being the pleasure of the eye and the hand. Although he never claimed any dogma, always preferring to keep his freedom, fantasy nevertheless remained the common thread running through his work. He married the drive of life with its springs of creation and did not hesitate to experiment with new techniques such as the rayograph, the photogram, double exposure, photomontage and photocollage.

Settling permanently in Paris in 1933, Pierre Jahan joined photographers such as Brassaï, Robert Doisneau and Henri Cartier-Bresson, who were eager to show a different Paris, in all its facets. He moved from images rooted in the real world, at times merciless, such as his pictures of the Occupation or of the fight for the Liberation of Paris, to his imaginary fantasies, at times full of humor. Pierre Jahan has the rare talent of slipping seamlessly between the disparate worlds of reportage photography and Surrealism, particularly at a time when artistic ideologies were unfolding militantly in successive manifestos. Jahan’s work crosses the twentieth century at a slant, unconstrained. It is at times grave and metaphorical, at times wandering and playful, always full of lyricism. The artist practices, and pushes to their limits, all the photographic techniques offered by his time a true testing ground – to create a body of work at once rooted in Surrealism and resolutely singular.

article_text:
神奈川県立歴史博物館（横浜市）が約1年9か月の休館を経て、10月17日（土）にリニューアルオープンしました。LED化やスポットライトなど照明の更新、映り込みが大幅に減った展示ケースのガラスなど、鑑賞空間が格段に向上しています。 LED化で同じケース内でも陶磁器と絵画で光を変えるなど作品に合ったライティングが可能に

特別展「入門！神奈川県立歴史博物館―県博の守り伝えていくコレクション―」は12月13日（日）まで。同館所蔵の4件の国指定重要文化財や教科書採用の有名作品など、多彩なコレクションがまとめてお披露目されています。リニューアルオープンを記念して、17日に続いて、10月18日（日）も入館無料です。

ミュージアムショップも新グッズが並び充実

（読売新聞美術展ナビ編集班 岡本公樹）

特別展「入門！神奈川県立歴史博物館―県博の守り伝えていくコレクション―」

会場：神奈川県立歴史博物館 （横浜市中区南仲通5-60）

会期：2026年10月17日（土）～12月13日（日） ［前期：10/17～11/15／後期：11/17～12/13］

開館時間：9:30～17:00（入館は16:30まで） ※11/20（金）は19:00まで開館時間延長（入館は18:30まで）

休館日：毎週月曜日（11月23日［月・祝］は開館）

観覧料：一般600円（ 850円 ）、20歳未満・学生400円（ 550円 ）、65歳以上200円（250円）、高校生100円（200円） ※（ ）は常設展とのセット券 ※中学生以下無料 ※10/17（土）・18（日）、11/3（火・祝）は観覧無料 ※障害者手帳等をお持ちの方と介助者（原則2名まで）は無料

アクセス： みなとみらい線「馬車道駅」3・5番出口から徒歩1分 JR「桜木町駅」新南口（ICカード専用）から徒歩5分 市営地下鉄「関内駅」9番出口から徒歩5分

詳細は、 神奈川県立歴史博物館公式サイト まで。

プレビュー

神奈川県立歴史博物館（横浜市中区）で、特別展「入門！神奈川県立歴史博物館―県博の守り伝えていくコレクション―」が10月17日から開催されます。

同館は、設備等改修工事のため、2025年1月以来約1年9カ月ぶりの再開館となります。特別展では、神奈川県立歴史博物館自慢のコレクションの数々をまとめて見ることができます。約1年9か月の休館を経て、展示室の照明のLED化、展示ケースのガラスに反射を抑えるフィルムの設置、新しい展示台の導入が行われ、エレベーターの更新など展示環境も大きく変わりました。

再開館最初の特別展はこの新しい環境で、珠玉の館蔵コレクションをじっくりと楽しむことができるでしょう。

贅沢な「入門！」展

神奈川県立歴史博物館所蔵のコレクションをまとめて見られる機会は約8年ぶりとなります。

国指定重要文化財の十王図（4幅を前期・後期で2幅ずつ）・色々威腹巻・二十八間四方白星兜鉢・二十四間四方白星兜鉢の4件を約20年ぶりに同時に展示。源頼朝のサインとして有名な源頼朝袖判下文、教科書でおなじみの時宗の一遍上人像をはじめ、近年評価も人気も高まった五姓田義松の老母図、神奈川県立歴史博物館所蔵の神奈川県指定重要文化財の作品・資料がほぼ網羅されます。

また、神奈川県立歴史博物館が誇る浮世絵の丹波恒夫コレクションからは、歌川広重の代表作東海道五十三次のうち県内の川崎～箱根までの9点が一堂に展示されます（前期）。

さらに、今年3月開催のトークフェスで紹介した学芸員が選んだ逸品もズラリと並びます（※一部は常設展で展示）。収蔵品のすべては紹介できませんが、小田原北条氏の虎の印判状、眞葛焼、仏像、歴史資料、刀剣、工芸品と幅広いラインナップとなっています。

約1年9か月という長い休館期間を経て、最新のLED照明や低反射ガラスフィルムなど、鑑賞環境を格段に向上させて待望の再開館を果たす神奈川県立歴史博物館。その記念すべき再開館第1弾となる本展は、名品選でありながら約8年ぶりとなる大規模な館蔵コレクション展です。約20年ぶりに一堂に会する国指定重要文化財4件をはじめ、源頼朝の自筆花押が残る貴重な古文書、教科書でも広く知られる一遍上人像、近年再評価の著しい五姓田義松の近代洋画、そして広重が描いた神奈川の宿場風景まで、神奈川の悠久の歴史と豊かな美の精華を余すところなく堪能できます。特にオープニングとなる17日、18日の2日間は、特別展・常設展ともに観覧無料。ぜひ、生まれ変わった神奈川県立歴史博物館をたっぷりと楽しんでみてはいかがでしょうか。（美術展ナビ）

article_text:
EXCLUSIVE : FilmNation Entertainment will launch AFM sales on thriller State Of Emergency under its genre production label Infrared Pictures.

Starring Brittany O’Grady ( The White Lotus ), Golden Globe and Emmy-winning director Greg Yaitanes, known for his work on hit series including House of the Dragon, Presumed Innocent, and House , will direct.

Infrared Pictures, Sam Brown and Dustin Thomason will produce through their company Curiosity Media. Infrared is financing. The film is expected to start shooting next year. Written by Nick Luddington ( Arcane ), State Of Emergency sees “Jenna return to her job as a Boston 911 emergency dispatcher where she’s still haunted by the death of her teenage brother and the missed call he placed to her in his final moments. What begins as an ordinary overnight shift soon takes a turn when callers report strange incidents connected to a mysterious event in Boston Harbor. And as a threat closes in on the dispatch center itself, the film gives way to a chilling realization: Boston is ground zero for a catastrophe.”

Related Stories

Holt McCallany Serial Killer Thriller 'Paradise Disturbed' Heads To AFM With Stoic; See The First-Look Image

AMP Boards Worldwide Sales On Topical Techno-Horror 'Modem' - AFM

Yaitanes most recently directed on Lucky , Dutton Ranch and Spider-Noir . He served as executive producer and director on Apple TV+’s most viewed drama, Presumed Innocent , starring Jake Gyllenhaal. He was co-executive producer of House of the Dragon , for which he also directed three episodes including the season finale, which drew HBO’s largest global audience ever, and previously won an Emmy for House .

Watch on Deadline

The White Lotus star O’Grady recently starred in Kathryn Bigelow’s A House Of Dynamite , genre title Monitor , HBO Max’s The Comeback and has Jumanji: Open World upcoming.

Director Yaitanes said: “I’m excited to reunite with my longtime collaborators Dustin Thomason and Sam Brown, and to work with a rising talent like Brittany O’Grady. The thriller genre has been a lifelong passion of mine. FilmNation has built an extraordinary body of work, and I’m proud to be part of their creative community as we bring this project to the screen.” FilmNation Entertainment founder & CEO Glen Basner added: “Infrared is a champion of bold genre films and we can’t wait to bring Greg Yaitanes’ high-stakes, survival thriller State Of Emergency to audiences worldwide.”

title_original: Auction of Nazi-Looted Torah Fragment Canceled After Outcry and Israeli Government Intervention
editorial_title_zh: 纳粹劫掠的托拉经卷残片拍卖在引发强烈抗议与以色列政府干预后取消
editorial_excerpt_zh: 这件被拍卖行描述为“由德国党卫军士兵掠夺”的文物在竞拍中以超估价的8,500美元成交，但将被捐赠给一家纪念机构。
editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "在挪威一家拍卖行试图出售一件被纳粹劫掠的托拉经卷残片后，引发了公众的强烈抗议。", "links": [{"text": "auction", "url": "https://www.artnews.com/t/auction/"}], "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "据《犹太电讯社》（JTA）报道，以色列外交部长吉德翁·萨尔（Gideon Sa'ar）也进行了干预，据外交部发言人称，他要求以色列驻挪威大使馆阻止此次拍卖。“多亏了大使馆的努力，拍卖已被取消，这份羊皮经卷将被捐赠给美国的一个大屠杀纪念机构，”一位外交部发言人告诉《犹太电讯社》。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "此前，以色列外交部曾将原定于10月18日举行的这场拍卖称为“奥斯陆的一场纳粹狂欢”。", "links": [{"text": "called", "url": "https://x.com/IsraelMFA/status/2111821806738817171"}], "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "位于奥斯陆的瓦尔基里历史拍卖行（Valkyrie Historical Auctions）在其“第三帝国历史物品”网络拍卖会上列出了这件文物。该托拉经卷残片缺乏完整的专家出处确认。拍品描述写道：“极古老的犹太托拉经卷残片，在大屠杀（Soah）期间被德国党卫军士兵掠夺，并作为纪念品寄给了一位亲戚。这件物品是用小牛皮手写的，可能因火灾而受损。上面写有士兵部队的野战邮政编号（feldpost），并直接写明了寄往德国的收件地址。”", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "据《犹太新闻》（Jewish News）报道，该拍卖行进一步将这件物品（在现已结束的拍卖中仍列为第83号拍品）描述为“欧洲犹太人及其文化和传统遭受毁灭的悲惨而有力的象征”。其估价在1,500美元至2,000美元之间，并由一位匿名竞标者以8,500美元拍下，不过拍卖行表示交易尚未完成。", "links": [{"text": "listed as lot 83", "url": "https://www.valkyrieauctions.com/auction/252-historical-3rd-reich/lot-83-very-old/"}, {"text": "Jewish News", "url": "https://www.jewishnews.co.uk/nazi-looted-torah-auction-cancelled-following-israeli-protest/"}], "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "目前尚不清楚这家网络拍卖行在何种情况下或在多大程度上取消了拍卖，也不清楚该托拉经卷残片最终是否从其所有者手中被买下然后捐赠。ARTnews 的置评请求未立即得到回复。根据其网站介绍，瓦尔基里历史拍卖行是“二战和大屠杀时期文物的专家”，由历史学家诺伯特·波德莱斯尼（Norbert Podlesny）领导，他曾撰写过关于纳粹时期犹太人迫害的文章。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "尽管尚未最终敲定，但位于圣迭戈的大屠杀纪念机构“记住我们”（Remember Us The Holocaust, 简称 RUTH）告诉《犹太电讯社》，他们一直在努力通过“适当的处理和恭敬的展览”方式来获取并保存这件托拉经卷残片。RUTH 执行董事莫伊塞斯·萨利纳斯·弗莱特曼（Moisés Salinas Fleitman）确实表示，该机构收到了电子邮件确认，称该文物将捐赠给他们，但仍在等待最终敲定。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "一些人现在要求对该拍卖如何在被列为劫掠品的情况下得以成行展开进一步调查，并呼吁采取更广泛的努力来遏制被劫掠犹太物品的出售。“这不仅仅是一件古董或历史珍品。这是一件神圣的犹太物品，代表着一个社群的宗教生活以及该生活在大屠杀期间遭受的毁灭性破坏，”世界犹太人赔偿组织（WJRO）主席吉德翁·泰勒（Gideon Taylor）告诉《犹太电讯社》。", "translated": true}]
article_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "After an auction house in Norway attempted to sell a fragment of a Torah scroll looted by the Nazis, a public outcry ensued.", "links": [{"text": "auction", "url": "https://www.artnews.com/t/auction/"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Israel’s Foreign Minister Gideon Sa’ar also intervened and, according to a ministry spokesperson, asked the Israeli embassy in Norway to prevent the sale, reports the Jewish Telegraphic Agency (JTA). “Thanks to the embassy’s efforts, the auction was canceled, and the parchment will be donated to a Holocaust remembrance organization in the United States,” a foreign ministry spokesperson told the JTA."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Previously, Israel’s foreign ministry had called the sale, which had been scheduled for October 18, “A Nazi celebration in Oslo.”", "links": [{"text": "called", "url": "https://x.com/IsraelMFA/status/2111821806738817171"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "The Valkyrie Historical Auctions in Oslo listed the artifact on its “Historical 3rd Reich Items” online auction. The torah fragment lacks complete expert confirmation of its provenance. A description for the lot reads, “Very Old Piece of Jewish Torah Roll Plundered by SS German Soldiers During Soah and sent to a relative as a souvenir. This piece is handwritten in calfskin and damaged probaby [ sic ] by fire. It has the feldpost of the soldier unit written on it and directly written on it the address in Germany to whom it was sent.”"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "The house further described the item, still listed as lot 83 on the now completed sale, as a “sad and powerful symbol of the destruction of European Jews and their culture and tradition.” It was valued at between $1,500 and $2,000, and was won for $8,500 by an unknown bidder, though the auction house said the transaction had not been completed, according to Jewish News .", "links": [{"text": "listed as lot 83", "url": "https://www.valkyrieauctions.com/auction/252-historical-3rd-reich/lot-83-very-old/"}, {"text": "Jewish News", "url": "https://www.jewishnews.co.uk/nazi-looted-torah-auction-cancelled-following-israeli-protest/"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "It is also unclear under what circumstances or to what extent the online auction house canceled the sale, or whether the Torah fragment was ultimately purchased from its owner and then donated. article_text:
After an auction house in Norway attempted to sell a fragment of a Torah scroll looted by the Nazis, a public outcry ensued.

Israel’s Foreign Minister Gideon Sa’ar also intervened and, according to a ministry spokesperson, asked the Israeli embassy in Norway to prevent the sale, reports the Jewish Telegraphic Agency (JTA). “Thanks to the embassy’s efforts, the auction was canceled, and the parchment will be donated to a Holocaust remembrance organization in the United States,” a foreign ministry spokesperson told the JTA.

Previously, Israel’s foreign ministry had called the sale, which had been scheduled for October 18, “A Nazi celebration in Oslo.”

The Valkyrie Historical Auctions in Oslo listed the artifact on its “Historical 3rd Reich Items” online auction. The torah fragment lacks complete expert confirmation of its provenance. A description for the lot reads, “Very Old Piece of Jewish Torah Roll Plundered by SS German Soldiers During Soah and sent to a relative as a souvenir. This piece is handwritten in calfskin and damaged probaby [ sic ] by fire. It has the feldpost of the soldier unit written on it and directly written on it the address in Germany to whom it was sent.”

The house further described the item, still listed as lot 83 on the now completed sale, as a “sad and powerful symbol of the destruction of European Jews and their culture and tradition.” It was valued at between $1,500 and $2,000, and was won for $8,500 by an unknown bidder, though the auction house said the transaction had not been completed, according to Jewish News .

It is also unclear under what circumstances or to what extent the online auction house canceled the sale, or whether the Torah fragment was ultimately purchased from its owner and then donated. ARTnews ’s request for comment was not immediately returned. According to its website, the Valkyrie Historical Auctions are “specialists in WWII and Holocaust-era artifacts,” led by historian Norbert Podlesny, who has written about the persecution of Jews during the Nazi era.

Though it has not been finalized, Remember Us The Holocaust (RUTH), a remembrance organization in San Diego, told JTA they had been working to obtain and preserve the Torah fragment using “appropriate treatment and respectful exhibition” methods. RUTH executive director Moisés Salinas Fleitman did say the organization received an email confirmation that the artifact would be donated to them, but was awaiting its finalization.

Some are now demanding further investigation into how the auction came about despite it being listed as looted, as well as broader efforts to stem the sale of plundered Jewish items. “This is not simply an antique or a historical curiosity. It is a sacred Jewish object that represents a community’s religious life and the devastating destruction of that life during the Holocaust,” Gideon Taylor, president of the World Jewish Restitution Organization (WJRO), told the JTA.
excerpt_original: The artifact described by the auction house as “plundered by SS German Soldiers” was won for $8,500, in a bid over its estimate, but will be donated to a remembrance organization.

title_original: 「ターナー賞2026」（ミドルズブラ現代美術館）レポート。個人を超えた歴史と構造に向き合う表現
editorial_title_zh: “2026年透纳奖”（米德尔斯堡现代美术馆）报道：直面超越个人的历史与结构的表现
editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/e050f50d/3a590251-da75-4974-979e-35efecb415f4.jpg?w=2352&q=70&fm=webp", "alt": "", "caption": "paragraph", "text": "入围今年透纳奖的艺术家包括多媒体艺术家西梅翁·巴克利（Simeon Barclay）、雕塑家基拉·弗雷杰（Kira Freije）、主要从事装置创作的法国艺术家玛格丽特·于莫（Marguerite Humeau），以及涉足雕塑、影像、素描等多元创作的塔诺亚·萨斯拉克（Tanoa Sasraku）。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/44d250dd/eb3c8196-5506-40ce-8a68-24e34d9a5def.jpg?q=70&fm=webp", "alt": "", "caption": "米德尔斯堡现代美术馆外景，从约克再乘1小时火车　摄影：作者", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "2026年的入围作品展在位于英格兰北部米德尔斯堡的提赛德大学米德尔斯堡现代美术馆（MIMA）举办。这是透纳奖首次在大学机构举办。展期为9月26日至2027年3月29日。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "最近几年的透纳奖入围者，往往倾向于根植于艺术家个人身份或根基的表现。然而，当看完1楼展厅的3位艺术家作品时，我直觉今年有所不同。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "例如，萨斯拉克拥有英国和加纳的混合血统且身为酷儿艺术家，但她似乎在探索一种不让自身身份过于前置的创作方式。此外，巴克利虽然立足于第二代移民、黑人男性以及英格兰北部工人阶级的出身，但从实际看到的作品中，可以感受到他不仅局限于个人经验，更关注探问群体和地区等集体所共享的记忆与身份。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/7eb40d6a/5a7604d8-a709-489d-a68e-fe6bedd68e07.jpg?q=70&fm=webp", "alt": "", "caption": "设立在入口附近的候选人介绍专区　摄影：作者", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "今年这4位艺术家的共同点在于，他们以个人经验或存在作为出发点，同时将视野拓展至超越个人尺度的议题。弗雷杰通过舍弃具体或社会性的语境来迫近人类的普遍情感，于莫依托科幻与生态学的想象力呈现生命的地球史，萨斯拉克深入挖掘与土地和国家紧密相连的枯竭性资源权力动力学，巴克利则剖析英格兰北部的社会史。尽管入围者们处理的素材和主题各不相同，但给人的感觉是，这些表现都在重新审视个人与环绕着个人的更大外部之间的关系。", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "玛格丽特·于莫：呈现超越生死、历久弥新的地球史", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "凭借在丹麦哥本哈根阿尔肯现代美术馆以及芬兰赫尔辛基美术馆举办的回顾展“火把（Torches）”获得提名的是常驻伦敦的法国艺术家于莫。她从生态中心的视角，展现了万物生灵的生与死，以及具有推测性的未来。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/ee3dcad8/e601deed-eb62-466a-b2d6-ccfde6f8a1b7.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "展场风貌，玛格丽特·于莫《ECHO, A Matriarch Engineered to Die》（2016）　Photo: David Levene", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "步入第一个展厅，绕过遮挡视线的半透明白色布帘，迎面便是一头宽度约4米的大象。倾听之下，可以听到微弱的心跳声。正是通过这个声音，我们得知眼前这头趴着的白而光滑的大象正处于奄奄一息的状态。随着临终时刻的临近，声景中不知从何处重叠起其他大象的叫喊，不久便转变成带有短调回响的哀悼合唱。如果大象群落是因为经历了同伴的死亡为契机，从而萌生出新的情感、意识与交流──。本作便是以这样一个科幻式的假设为出发点的于莫的代表作。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/08083a65/16b8fef9-f73d-4bf4-aae0-68b2de020309.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "展场风貌，玛格丽特·于莫《The Holder of Wasp Venom》（2023）　摄影：作者", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "另一个展厅则弥漫着蜂蜡的香气。每走一步，奶油色的地毯都柔和地包裹着双足，十分舒适。中央设置的《The Holder of Wasp Venom》也笼罩在有机且充满血肉感的氛围中。这与前一个展厅中聚苯乙烯材质的大象所散发出的人工且略带冰冷的医疗设施印象形成了鲜明对比。《The Holder of Wasp Venom》的材质并非活物。尽管如此，以树龄150年的胡桃木为中心，蜂蜡制成的蜂巢如蘑菇般丛生的景象，却不由得唤起了一种强烈的生命感，仿佛昆虫、微生物和真菌的生命周期正活生生地在此地呼吸。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "于莫通过这些作品所呈现的，是远超个体生死的历久弥新的地球史。即便人类消失后，世界仍将继续。或者说，即便一个生命的灯火熄灭，它也会传承给其他生命或物质。这是一位擅长编织故事、兼具文学趣味的艺术家。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/6e227f1c/6a09e178-286b-4c4d-849a-6ab1d3a09d82.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "展场风貌，玛格丽特·于莫《The Holder of Wasp Venom》（2023）局部　摄影：作者", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "话虽如此，对于莫我也感到一丝困惑。即便考虑到被提名的个展是一场回顾展这一情况，将10年前的代表作《ECHO》作为核心作品展出的做法依然留有疑问。考虑到透纳奖并非旨在表彰艺术家整个职业生涯的功劳奖，而是倾向于定点观测式的奖项，旨在评价为近年英国美术发展做出贡献的活动与表现，那么以近作来构成展览或许才是妥当的。", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "塔诺亚·萨斯拉克：连接石油、土地与家族记忆的地缘政治", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "因在伦敦当代艺术研究所（ICA）举办个展“道德补丁（Morale Patch）”而受到赞誉的萨斯拉克，通过作为历史与记忆媒介的物质——从石油产业及军队相关的纪念品、徽章到服装纸样，切入了关于战争、民族主义以及资源开采的权力结构。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/6f22188f/cc615011-1017-45bb-b2e8-ae79c54931a2.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "展场风貌，塔诺亚·萨斯拉克《Watchlist》（2025）　摄影：作者", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "首先迎客的是让人联想起国际象棋的作品《Watchlist》。作为石油公司纪念品的32个丙烯酸纸镇，被放置在比喻海洋、沙漠或积雪地带等的黑、橙、白、蓝方格中。每个纸镇内都封存着采自西伯利亚、阿拉斯加、得克萨斯、沙特阿拉伯、北海等实际开采区的原油，萨斯拉克如排兵布阵般巧妙地布局这些“棋子”。例如，美国和沙特阿拉伯的棋子被放置得很近。这件作品通过石油将相互结盟又时而对立的国家间关系，虚拟地映射为某种游戏的棋盘。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/d39d6652/a2985c3f-b460-4d8e-a2d7-2664ef3e4465.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "封入沙特阿拉伯产原油的纸镇　摄影：作者", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "与此相对，在《Watchlist》身后高约4米的纸本作品《Mascot》中，个人史与围绕开采资源的大历史连接在了一起。作品中央隐约可见的凹陷线条，是曾为服装设计师的萨斯拉克的父亲所象征的服装纸样（即吉祥物）。父亲的故乡加纳以及萨斯拉克成长的英格兰西南部康沃尔，都是与采矿业有着深厚渊源的土地（加纳因开采黄金、康沃尔因开采锡和铜而繁荣）。萨斯拉克采用从这两片土地上采集的颜料，在厚重叠加的报纸载体上进行着色。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "如果说《Watchlist》以地缘政治的尺度处理了围绕世界各地石油资源的国家间关系，那么在《Mascot》中，资源与土地这一相同的问题则变奏为了家族记忆这一个人尺度。它将宏大历史拉近到个人的身体与记忆之中，同时又浮现出个人经验背后的土地历史与帝国痕迹。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/d44032e8/ee95f403-e658-41b4-82a0-49f5fb3eefaa.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "展场风貌，塔诺亚·萨斯拉克《Mascot》（2025）　Photo: David Levene", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "萨斯的魅力在于她能够将之落脚于极简且高度抽象化的形式中，并展现出精明的手腕。然而遗憾的是，两者的素材仅停留在支撑作品概念合乎逻辑的意义层面，对于物品本身的运用方式之趣味与讲究，却未能从视觉上传递出来。", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "西梅翁·巴克利：高速公路唤起的在郊外作为黑人成长的经历与记忆", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "因其个人首场行为艺术《废墟（The Ruin）》获得提名的巴克利，为本次展览将他在伦敦ICA、西约克郡赫普沃斯韦克菲尔德美术馆以及诺丁汉新艺术交换所上演的约1小时的行为表演重新构想为了一场录像装置。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/914c438c/79209366-3f95-47a3-b0b0-d8f9ee5f84df.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "展场风貌，西梅翁·巴克利《The Ruin》（2026）　Photo: David Levene", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "步入展厅，便被引入一个在黑暗中红灯隐约闪烁的可疑空间。战战兢兢地沿着宛如施工现场般的围挡行走，再穿过闪烁着绿色霓虹灯光的招牌后，终于抵达了围挡内部。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "围挡内部尽管是一个裸露着铁管的工业化空间，却又给人一种小巧且某种程度上亲密而私密的感觉。此外，天花板上积聚着五颜六色的气球堆，让人联想到儿童家庭派对，或是派对结束后的寂寞。公共基础设施与私人空间、欢乐与寂寞。这些相悖的元素正是《The Ruin》的核心。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/e050f50d/3a590251-da75-4974-979e-35efecb415f4.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "展场风貌，西梅翁·巴克利《The Ruin》（2026）　Photo: David Levene", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "作品中所涉及的是横跨英格兰北部东西两侧的高速公路M62。M62是支撑北部物流与经济的大动脉，也是战后英国代表性的基础设施工程之一。在建设当时，它曾是让人对英格兰北部走向繁荣的未来抱有期待的存在，也是将人们带往外部世界的出行自由的象征。巴克利出生并成长的哈德斯菲尔德，就位于这条M62的沿线。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "影像中播放着拍摄M62的静止画以及独白。", "translated": true}, {"type": "quote", "text": "遭受打击。在凛冽的风中。被掩盖。在纷纷扬扬的大雪中。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "然而，这些话语并未与黄昏下闪闪发光的道路风景说明挂钩。此外，在M62的影像前后，还插入了巴克利度过童年时光的起居室照片。也就是说，这里所讲述的与其说是道路本身，不如说是通过对艺术家而言具有象征意义的道路所唤起的记忆与情感吧。在谈论M62的同时，他也在谈论着除此之外的某些事物。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "英格兰北部有许多因工业革命而繁荣的工业城市，但它们大多在20世纪后半叶的去工业化进程中衰落，不少城市在经济和治安方面面临着课题。巴克利将曾经寄予地区发展期望的M62，与自己在英格兰北部小镇作为黑人成长的经历以及疏离感联系在了一起。通过复杂的感情层理，他试图立体地唤起英格兰北部不为人记录的一面。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/294315da/a76e2f78-2156-4d72-932a-e3668c1135d2.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "展场风貌，西梅翁·巴克利《The Ruin》（2026）　摄影：作者", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "以表演获得提名的巴克利，无疑是本次展览中最具棘手性的存在。在入围者展中，通常会在不同的条件下重新构想并展示被提名的展览或项目。然而在本次案例中，凸显出了以实体作品展示为前提的透纳奖入围者展那令人头疼的一面。", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "基拉·弗雷杰：以等身大雕塑群逼近人类的普遍情感", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "凭借从赫普沃斯韦克菲尔德美术馆巡展至牛津现代美术馆、作为艺术家首场大型个展的“打破合唱（Upspeak the Chorus）”获得提名的弗雷杰，展开了将模仿人类和动物的等身大雕塑与玻璃、布料等现成品相结合的创作。", "展场风貌，基拉·弗雷杰的展示　摄影：作者", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "L形展厅的墙面上贴着铝箔纸，空间显得比实际面积更具纵深感。此外还燃起了烟雾，照亮雕塑的光束在烟雾中美丽地浮现。这简直是一个宛如舞台布景般的空间。", "translated": true}, "2026年のファイナリスト作品展は、イングランド北部ミドルズブラにあるティーズサイド大学のミドルズブラ現代美術館（MIMA）で開催されている。大学機関でのターナー賞の開催は、今回が初めてとなる。会期は9月26日〜2027年3月29日。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "ここ数年のターナー賞ファイナリストは、作家個人のアイデンティティやルーツに根ざした表現が多い傾向にあった。だが、1階フロアの3人を見終わる頃には、今年は趣が異なると直感した。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "たとえば、サスラクはイギリスとガーナのミックスルーツかつクィアの作家であるが、自身のアイデンティティが前景化しない制作の在り方を探っているように思えた。また、バークレイは、移民第二世代・黒人男性・イングランド北部の労働者階級としての出自を足場にしつつも、実際に見た作品からは、個人の経験にとどまらず、コミュニティや地域といった集団が共有する記憶やアイデンティティを問うことに関心があるように感じられた。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/7eb40d6a/5a7604d8-a709-489d-a68e-fe6bedd68e07.jpg?q=70&fm=webp", "alt": "", "caption": "エントランス近くに設置された候補者の紹介コーナー　撮影：筆者", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "今年の4人に共通するのは、個人の経験や存在を出発点としながら、それを超えたスケールの問題へと視野を広げる態度だ。フレイジェは具体的ないしは社会的な文脈を捨象することで人間の普遍的な感情に肉薄し、ユモーはSFやエコロジーの想像力に支えられた生命の地球史を、サスラクは土地や国と紐づいた枯渇性資源のパワーダイナミクスを、バークレイはイングランド北部の社会史を掘り下げる。ファイナリストたちが扱う素材やテーマは異なるものの、いずれも、個人と個人をとりまくより大きな外部との関係を問い直す表現だと感じた。"}, {"type": "heading", "text": "マルグリット・ユモー：生死を超えた、悠久の地球史を提示する"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "デンマーク・コペンハーゲンのアルケン近代美術館および、フィンランドのヘルシンキ美術館で開催された回顧展「たいまつ（Torches）」がノミネートしたのは、ロンドンを拠点に活動するフランス人のユモー。エコセントリックな視点から、生きとし生けるものの生と死、そしてスペキュラティブな未来を示す。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/ee3dcad8/e601deed-eb62-466a-b2d6-ccfde6f8a1b7.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "会場風景より、マルグリット・ユモー《ECHO, A Matriarch Engineered to Die》（2016）　Photo: David Levene", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "最初の展示室に入り、視界を遮る半透明の白いカーテンを迂回すると、横幅4mほどの巨大な象に出迎えられる。耳を澄ますと、弱々しい鼓動が聞こえてくる。そして、この音によって、我々は、目の前で伏せっている白く滑らかな象が気息奄々の状態であることを知る。最期の瞬間が近づくにつれて、サウンドスケープはどこからともなくほかの象たちの鳴き声が重なり、やがて短調の響きを帯びた哀悼のコーラスへと変わっていく。もし象の群れが仲間の死を経験したことをきっかけに、新たな感情や意識、コミュニケーションが芽生えたとしたら──。本作は、そんなSF的な仮説を出発点にしたユモーの代表作である。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/08083a65/16b8fef9-f73d-4bf4-aae0-68b2de020309.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "会場風景より、マルグリット・ユモー《The Holder of Wasp Venom》（2023）　撮影：筆者", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "もうひとつの展示室は、蜜蝋の香りに満ちている。歩くたびにクリーム色のカーペットが足を柔らかく包み、心地よい。中央に設置された《The Holder of Wasp Venom》も、有機的で血の通った雰囲気をまとっている。先の展示室のポリスチレン製の象が、医療施設を思わせる人工的でやや冷たい印象を与えるのとは対照的だ。《The Holder of Wasp Venom》の素材は生きているわけではない。にもかかわらず、樹齢150年のクルミ材を中心に、蜜蝋製のハニカムがキノコのように群生する様子は、思わず昆虫・微生物・菌類の生のサイクルがこの場で息づいているような強い生の感覚を興す。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "こうした作品を通じてユモーが提示するのは、個体の生死をはるかに超えた、悠久の地球史である。人間がいなくなったあとにも、世界は続いていく。あるいは、ひとつの生命の灯が消えたとしても、それは別の生命や物質へと引き継がれていく。物語をつむぐ力に長けた、文学的な趣のある作家だ。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/6e227f1c/6a09e178-286b-4c4d-849a-6ab1d3a09d82.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "会場風景より、マルグリット・ユモー《The Holder of Wasp Venom》（2023） 部分　撮影：筆者", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "とはいえ、ユモーについては戸惑いも覚えた。ノミネート対象の個展が回顧展だったという事情を踏まえても、10年前の代表作《ECHO》を目玉作品として展示した点には疑問が残る。ターナー賞が作家のキャリア全体を評価する功労賞ではなく、近年のイギリス美術の発展に寄与した活動や表現を評価する定点観測的な賞を志向していることを鑑みれば、近作で構成するのが妥当だったのではないか。"}, {"type": "heading", "text": "タノア・サスラク：石油、土地、家族の記憶を結ぶ地政学"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "ロンドンのインスティテュート・オブ・コンテンポラリー・アーツ（ICA）での個展「モラルパッチ（Morale Patch）」が評価されたサスラクは、石油産業や軍にまつわる記念品・記章から衣服の型紙まで、歴史や記憶を媒介する物質を通じて、戦争やナショナリズム、そして資源採掘をめぐる権力構造に踏み込む。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/6f22188f/cc615011-1017-45bb-b2e8-ae79c54931a2.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "会場風景より、タノア・サスラク《Watchlist》（2025）　撮影：筆者", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "まず出迎えるのは、チェスを彷彿とさせる作品《Watchlist》だ。石油会社のノベルティである32個のアクリル製ペーパーウェイトが、海や砂漠、積雪地帯などになぞらえた黒・橙・白・青のマスに設置されている。各ペーパーウェイトの中には、シベリア、アラスカ、テキサス、サウジアラビア、北海など、実際の採掘地域で採られた原油が封じ込められており、サスラクはこれらを「駒」のように巧妙に配置する。たとえば、アメリカとサウジアラビアの駒は近くに置かれている。石油を介して結びつき、ときに対立する国家間の関係を、ある種のゲームの盤面として仮想的にマッピングした作品だ。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/d39d6652/a2985c3f-b460-4d8e-a2d7-2664ef3e4465.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "サウジアラビア産の原油が封入されたペーパーウェイト　撮影：筆者", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "これに対し、《Watchlist》の背後に控える高さ4mほどの紙作品《Mascot》では、採掘資源をめぐる大きな歴史に個人史が接続される。作品中央にうっすらと凹んだ線が見えるのは、ファッションデザイナーだったサスラクの父を象徴する衣服の型紙（＝マスコット）だ。父の故郷であるガーナと、サスラクが育ったイングランド西部のコーンウォールは、ともに鉱業と深い関わりを持つ土地である（ガーナは金、コーンウォールは錫や銅の採掘によって栄えた）。サスラクはこのふたつの土地から採取した顔料を用いて、分厚く重ねられた新聞紙の支持体に着彩する。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "《Watchlist》が世界各地の石油資源をめぐる国家間の関係を地政学的なスケールで扱うのに対し、《Mascot》では、資源と土地という同じ問題が、家族の記憶という個人的なスケールへと変奏される。大きな歴史を個人の身体や記憶へと引き寄せながら、同時に個人的な経験の背後にある土地の歴史や帝国の痕跡を浮かび上がらせるのである。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/d44032e8/ee95f403-e658-41b4-82a0-49f5fb3eefaa.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "会場風景より、タノア・サスラク《Mascot》（2025） Photo: David Levene", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "ミニマルで高度に抽象化された形式へと落とし込む、その怜悧な手つきがサスラクの魅力だ。しかし、いずれも素材はコンセプトの筋が通るように作品を支える意味のレベルにとどまり、モノそのものの扱い方の面白さやこだわりが視覚的に伝わってこないのが残念でもある。"}, Ruin）》がノミネートしたバークレイは、今回の展示のために、ロンドンのICAおよびウェスト・ヨークシャーのヘップワース・ウェイクフィールド、ノッティンガムのニュー・アート・エクスチェンジで上演した約1時間のパフォーマンスをビデオ・インスタレーションとして再構成した。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "Tokyo Art Beat"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "展示室に入ると、暗闇の中で赤いライトがぼんやり光る怪しい空間に誘われる。恐る恐る工事現場のような囲いに沿って歩き、さらに点滅する緑色のネオンサインの看板を通り過ぎると、ようやく囲いの内側に辿り着く。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "囲いの内側は、鉄パイプが剥き出しの工業的な空間にもかかわらず、こぢんまりとしてどこか親密でプライベートな空間を思わせる。そして、天井には色とりどりの風船の吹き溜まりができており、子供向けのホームパーティー、あるいはパーティーが終わったあとの寂しさを連想させる。公共的なインフラと私的な空間、楽しさと寂しさ。この相反する要素こそ《The Ruin》の核心だ。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/e050f50d/3a590251-da75-4974-979e-35efecb415f4.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "会場風景より、シメオン・バークレイ《The Ruin》（2026）　Photo:  David Levene", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "作品で取り上げられているのは、イングランド北部を東西に横断する高速道路のM62だ。M62とは、北部の物流や経済を支える大動脈であり、戦後英国を代表するインフラ事業のひとつである。そして建設当時は、イングランド北部が豊かになる未来を期待させる存在であり、外の世界へと連れ出してくれる移動の自由の象徴でもあった。バークレイが生まれ育ったハダースフィールドは、このM62の沿線にある。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "映像ではM62を写した静止画とともに、モノローグが流れる。"}, {"type": "quote", "text": "打ちのめされて。吹きつける風の中で。 覆い隠されて。降りしきる雪の中で。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "しかしこの言葉は夕暮れで輝く道路の風景の説明には結びつかない。さらにM62の映像の前後では、バークレイが子供時代を過ごしたリビングの写真も挿入される。すなわちここで語られているのは、道路そのものというよりも、作家にとって象徴的な道路を介して呼び起こされる記憶や感情なのではないか。M62について語りながら、同時にそれだけではない何かを語っているのである。"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "イングランド北部は産業革命で栄えた工業都市が多いが、いずれも20世紀後半の脱工業化で衰退し、経済面・治安面で課題を抱える街も少なくない。バークレイは、かつて地域の発展を期待させたM62に対し、イングランド北部の小さな街で黒人として育った経験や疎外感を結びつけている。複雑な感情のレイヤーを通じて、イングランド北部の記録に残らない側面を立体的に立ち上がらせようとしている。"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/294315da/a76e2f78-2156-4d72-932a-e3668c1135d2.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "会場風景より、シメオン・バークレイ《The Ruin》（2026）　撮影：筆者", "credit":
